nodes.description: Ammunition for a Shotgun.
Incendiary Shotgun Ammunition
Single large projectile for a Shotgun.

5.56 is the ammo for your rifles, and it loses velocity and a bit of damage at long range. Craft 3 rounds at a tier 2 workbench from 10 frags and 5 gunpowder, or mix the same batch at a [Mixing Table](/items/mixing-table). Research costs 100 scrap, or 17 blueprint pages total on the tech tree after the Thompson. Scientists at monuments, Cargo and [Oil Rig](/monument/oil-rig) carry 12-36 about half the time, and [cannon crates](/world/crate-cannons) drop 12-36 at 76%.
Asbestos insert providing extra protection from heat for crafted clothes and armor.
A stationary ballista, perfect for defence. Can fire deadly bolts at distant targets.

The Battering Ram is a siege weapon for smashing through twig, wood and stone builds, but not metal. It burns 30 low grade fuel a minute, needs HQM repairs to keep working, and takes 10 hits to break a [stone wall](/building/stone-wall). Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 500 wood, 2 [sheet metal](/items/sheet-metal), a [tarp](/items/tarp) and 100 HQM, with research at 40 scrap or 11 blueprint pages total on the tech tree. Killing one takes 4 C4 or 6 rockets.
A bunch of Bee Grenades in a single catapult projectile. Creates swarms of Bees on impact.
Sturdy work boots to keep your toes safe, you'd feel nothing if you kicked a table leg. Strong protection against the cold and incoming damage.
An improvised catapult siege weapon. Built for flinging destructive projectiles with questionable accuracy. Can be towed by horses.

The Chainsaw cuts through [trees](/world/tree) fast and needs low grade fuel to run. To repair one, use a Repair Bench, and you'll need the blueprint learned. [Outpost](/monument/outpost) sells it for 125 scrap, while the [Travelling Vendor](/world/travelling-vendor) (around 92) and Floating City shops (around 103) are cheaper when they have it in stock. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench with 5 HQM, 2 gears and 6 [metal blades](/items/metal-blade), or unlock it for 10 blueprint pages on the tech tree.
A Coffee Can Helmet. It provides a level of regional protection from inflicted damage.
A barricade made out of Stones.

The Cooking Workbench is the cooking station for advanced recipes, and it has 61 of them: bread, pies and teas need no blueprint, while low grade fuel, gunpowder, [explosives](/items/explosives) and some ammo do. Craft one at a tier 2 workbench for 200 frags, 200 stones and 100 wood. Research it for 40 [scrap](/items/scrap), or unlock it on the tier 2 tech tree past the [Large Furnace](/items/large-furnace) for 10 [blueprint pages](/items/blueprint-page) total. Loot drops are rare, around 1% at best.
A rapid-firing Machine Gun. Sacrifices accuracy and distance for speed.
A personal underwater propulsion device
Larger magazine size

The F1 Grenade is a military grenade you throw a short distance, deadly up close. Easiest way to get one is buying it for 8 scrap at the [Bandit Camp](/monument/bandit-camp) Black Market or a Floating City Bandit Weapons Shop. Crafting takes a tier 2 workbench, 30 gunpowder and 25 frags, with research at 40 scrap or 9 [blueprint pages](/items/blueprint-page) total on the tech tree. [Supply Drops](/world/supply-drop) carry 6-18 about half the time. A Green Recycler returns 15 gunpowder and 12 frags, plus a 50% chance at extra frags.
A crude firebomb made of fuel-filled jugs wrapped in a net. Can be placed or used as a projectile in a catapult.
A Flamethrower. Uses low grade fuel as ammunition.
A bright explosive device which blinds and disorients anyone near it upon detonation
A fragmentation mortar shell, dealing lethal damage in a large area on impact.

A Garage Door rolls up and down in a wall frame. Breaking one takes 5 propane bombs placed by hand or 3 launched from a [catapult](/items/catapult), or 2 C4, 3 rockets or 9 satchels against its 600 HP. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 300 frags and 2 [gears](/items/gears), once you have the blueprint for 40 [scrap](/items/scrap) at a research table or 7 [blueprint pages](/items/blueprint-page) on the tech tree. Looting one is rare, under 2% at best.

Gas Compression Overdrive is an internal mod for getting more out of each shot: 30% more velocity, 20% more damage and 20% more range, paid for with 20% less fire rate and 10% more recoil. It fits nine guns: M39, M92, Semi-Automatic Pistol, [M15 Semi-Automatic Pistol](/items/m15-semi-automatic-pistol), SAR, SKS, Custom SMG, Handmade SMG and Thompson. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 10 HQM after 100 [scrap](/items/scrap) to research or 21 [blueprint pages](/items/blueprint-page) through the tech tree. Crate drops are rare.
Heavy and solid bolt for a ballista, designed to hammer through doors.
You're under arrest! Use on a surrendering or wounded player to keep them restrained. The wearer is blocked from using or holding items and can be pushed around.

The Hazmat Suit is rubber gear made to resist radiation. Easiest way to get one is buying it for around 87 scrap from the Floating City shops. You can also craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 4 [tarps](/items/tarp), 2 [sewing kits](/items/sewing-kit) and 7 HQM after researching it for 60 scrap. For loot, the [scientist RHIB drybox](/world/rhib-drybox) drops 1-2 about 27% of the time. In a Green Recycler it gives 2 tarps, 1 sewing kit and 3 HQM, plus a 50% chance at extra HQM.
Offers superior protection at the cost of reduced vision and movement speed.
Offers superior protection at the cost of aiming down sights and reduced movement speed.
Offers superior protection at the cost of reduced movement speed.
High Caliber Revolver
A high stone gate, allowing access in and out of your compound.
A high stone wall used to keep people off your property.
Equipping these horse shoes will grant your horse additional movement speed

The HV rocket is fast rocket ammo for short to medium range, with large splash but less damage than a normal rocket. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench from 1 metal pipe and 100 [gun powder](/items/gun-powder), once you've unlocked it past the Rocket Launcher on the tech tree, 22 blueprint pages total. The [Gone Killing](/world/gone-killing) mission at Floating City pays 6 plus a launcher. [Bradley crates](/world/bradley-crate) drop 3-6 at 19%, [heli crates](/world/heli-crate) 3 at 15%.

The Holosight, or holo, is a scope-slot sight with 1.5x zoom and tighter aim, and it fits 30 weapons, such as the AK, LR-300 and MP5. To get one, craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 12 HQM and 1 [tech trash](/items/tech-trash), after researching it for 100 [scrap](/items/scrap) or unlocking it for 20 [blueprint pages](/items/blueprint-page) total on the tech tree. [Scientist RHIB dryboxes](/world/rhib-drybox) drop it around 12% of the time, while locked and elite crates rarely do.
Homemade Landmine. If you stand on one, you can ask a friend to disarm it before it explodes.
Fast moving rocket ammunition. Uses a type of radar for active target guidance from a Homing Launcher

The Homing Missile Launcher, or homing launcher, fires guided missiles, and you have to keep the target tracked until impact. [Flares](/items/flare) can distract them. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 20 HQM, 3 metal pipes, 1 [tech trash](/items/tech-trash) and 1 [CCTV camera](/items/cctv-camera), with the blueprint at 100 scrap to research or 21 blueprint pages on the tech tree. Crate drops are rare. [Homing Missiles](/items/homing-missile) also need tier 2: 2 pipes, 100 gunpowder and 1 tech trash makes 2.
A hoodie.
This ammunition travels faster, resulting in less drop and slightly higher damage when fired over long distances.
A fire-tipped bolt for a ballista, wrapped in burning cloth, ignites upon impact.
Slower moving ammunition that deals fire damage. There's a small chance it will start a fire.
Creates flames upon impact.

The Ladder Hatch fits into a floor frame, twig through armored, and opens into a ladder so you can climb between floors. Raid cost is 1 C4, 2 rockets or 4 satchels, while F1 grenades take 50 stuck or 500 thrown. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench from a [Wooden Ladder](/items/wooden-ladder), 300 frags and 3 [gears](/items/gears). The [Bradley Crate](/world/bradley-crate) is the best drop at 30%, and other loot is rare, 1.56% at best.

The Large Furnace is the big [furnace](/items/furnace) for smelting large quantities of ore, but it must be placed on terrain, so it's tough to secure. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 500 stones, 600 wood and 75 low grade fuel, research it for 100 scrap, or buy it at [Outpost](/monument/outpost) for 350 scrap. It rarely drops from locked and elite crates. To destroy one, use 3 C4, 2 incendiary rockets or 5 molotovs.

The Large Medkit heals you to max health over time and stops bleeding instantly, and keeping one in your toolbar guarantees you stand up from the wounded state. Buy one for around 26 scrap at Floating City Medical Shops and Casino Bar Shopkeepers or the [Water Well Shopkeeper](/world/water-well-npc), when in stock. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench from 2 [medical syringes](/items/medical-syringe) and 10 low grade fuel, with research at 40 scrap. Medical crates drop one half the time.
Lead insert that adds radiation protection for crafted clothes and armor.

The Locker stores your clothes and armor, with 42 slots, 21 of them for clothes, and it takes a code or [key lock](/items/key-lock). You can buy one at [Bandit Camp](/monument/bandit-camp) for 40 scrap, though that price moves. To craft it, it's 100 frags and 50 wood at a tier 2 workbench, after 40 scrap to research or 8 [blueprint pages](/items/blueprint-page) through the tech tree. Locked and elite crates only rarely drop one, and it has skins.
A powerful 2-handed melee weapon with good range and high damage.

The Medical Syringe, or med stick, heals 15 HP right away plus 20 over time, and takes off 10 radiation and 5 poison. Left-click heals you, right-click heals a target. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 15 cloth, 10 frags and 10 low grade fuel, or kill Heavy Scientists at Bradley or [Oil Rig](/monument/oil-rig), who drop 1-3 about 89% of the time. Floating City medical shops usually stock 2 for around 14 scrap.

The Metal Barricade is a tough barrier with barbed wire that damages players and slows them down. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 200 frags and 2 [metal blades](/items/metal-blade), with the blueprint at 100 scrap on a research table or 5 blueprint pages on the tech tree. Loot drops are rare, 1.56% at best, and [Locked Crates](/world/locked-crate), [Oil Rig](/monument/oil-rig) ones included, sit at 1.34%. To break one, bring 2 C4, 3 rockets, 8 satchels or 38 thrown Beancan Grenades.
Static shutter that forms a metal horizontal embrasure over your window frame.
A large sturdy metal shield, keeps arrows and bullets at bay. Usable with single handed weapons and tools.

The Metal Vertical Embrasure is a static shutter that forms a vertical metal embrasure over your window frame. To break a window embrasure, bring 2 C4, 4 rockets or 13 satchels. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 100 frags, with the blueprint at 20 [scrap](/items/scrap) on a research table or 5 [blueprint pages](/items/blueprint-page) on the tech tree. Loot drops are rare, 1.56% at best.
A glass bottle filled with low grade fuel. Smashes and spreads fire when it lands, incredibly high damage to wood and players but innefective against stronger materials.

The Mortar is a placed launcher that fires in an arc and favors volume over precision, so pair it with [binoculars](/items/binoculars). It fires Mortar Shells, which are high explosive but only deal minor structural damage, and Fragmentation Mortar Shells, which deal lethal damage in a large area. Craft the Mortar at a tier 2 workbench for 15 HQM and a [metal pipe](/items/metal-pipe), with the blueprint at 100 [scrap](/items/scrap) to research or 19 [blueprint pages](/items/blueprint-page) on the tech tree.
A high explosive mortar shell that deals minor structural damage on impact.
A ballista mounted on wheels, designed for mobility and capable of firing bolts at distant targets. Can be towed by horses.
Increases weapon fire rate by channeling gasses back into the weapon cycling it faster, at the cost of bullet accuracy.
Lowers recoil felt by the operator but can make bullet path more unpredictable and dealing slightly less damage to your foes.

Night Vision Goggles (NVGs) let you see at night by projecting and amplifying infrared light, but you can't wear them with a helmet. Recharge the batteries at a tier 2 workbench. Buy a pair for 250 scrap at [Bandit Camp](/monument/bandit-camp) or a Floating City, or craft them at tier 2 for 10 HQM and 2 [tech trash](/items/tech-trash). The blueprint costs 100 scrap to research or 6 [blueprint pages](/items/blueprint-page) on the tech tree. Loot drops are rare, 1.56% at best.
Significantly reduces the sound of gunfire, and completely removes any visible muzzle flash. Fashioned out of an old oil filter, this won't last long.

The parachute is gear you wear and open mid-air. To use it, equip it, then press your jump key while in mid-air to pull the cord and deploy it. You need to be at least 15m above the ground, and it must be repacked after each use. Craft one at a tier 2 workbench for 2 [tarp](/items/tarp), 2 [sewing kits](/items/sewing-kit) and 50 cloth, after 100 [scrap](/items/scrap) to research or 3 [blueprint pages](/items/blueprint-page) through the tech tree. Crate drops are rare.
A piercing bolt for a ballista, capable of penetrating armored vehicles.
A wide-impact bolt for a ballista, covering a large area while dealing moderate damage.
A prison cell gate to lock things behind bars

The Prison Cell Wall slots into a wall frame, twig up to armored, to build a jail cell into your base. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 150 metal frags, after unlocking it for 40 [scrap](/items/scrap) at a research table or 5 [blueprint pages](/items/blueprint-page) total on the tech tree, past the [Prison Cell Gate](/items/prison-cell-gate). Locked and elite crates drop it rarely. For raid cost, it takes 2 rockets, 1 C4 or 5 satchels to bring one down.

Propane bombs, or Propane Explosive Bombs, are kegs for wrecking structures, placed by hand or launched from a [catapult](/items/catapult). One does about 82 damage to a [stone wall](/building/stone-wall) placed or 138 from a catapult, so that wall takes 7 or 4. [Sheet metal](/items/sheet-metal) takes 13 or 8, armored 25 or 15. Craft one at tier 2 from an [Empty Propane Tank](/items/empty-propane-tank), 450 gun powder and 20 low grade fuel. Research is 40 scrap, or 18 blueprint pages on the tech tree.
A Shotgun. Fires 8 rounds.
A High Powered six-shooter.
A shoddy piece of body armor made from roadsigns.
A shoddy piece of leg armor made from roadsigns. Moderate protection from melee and projectiles.
Gloves made out of metal, offer a good amount of protection to the upper body.
A full body armor for a horse. Provides strong protection for you and your steed, at the cost of greatly reduced movement speed.
Unmatched craftsmanship meets devastating firepower.
A high-yield resource gathering axe. Slower than the Hatchet.
A high-yield resource gathering Icepick.
Ammunition for a SAM Site. This missile contains a rudimentary guidance system to help it navigate through strong winds.

The SAR, or Semi-Automatic Rifle, is a semi auto gun you can buy, loot or craft. The [Travelling Vendor](/world/travelling-vendor) sells it for around 108 scrap when it's stocked, and [supply drops](/world/supply-drop) carry 1-2 about 23% of the time. The recipe takes a tier 2 workbench, a [Semi Automatic Body](/items/semi-automatic-body), a [Metal Spring](/items/metal-spring), 450 frags and 4 HQM, with the blueprint at 100 scrap to research or 19 blueprint pages on the tech tree.
A cluster of heavy rock projectiles for a catapult. Wide spread, pure kinetic damage on impact.

The P2, or semi auto pistol, is a sidearm that fires rapidly with good accuracy. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench from a [Semi Automatic Body](/items/semi-automatic-body), 6 HQM and a [Metal Pipe](/items/metal-pipe). Research costs 100 scrap, or 8 blueprint pages total through the tech tree. It drops from elite crates (around 7%) and from heavy scientists at Bradley and [Oil Rig](/monument/oil-rig) (around 5%). In a Green Recycler it gives 3 HQM, plus a 50% chance each at the body and pipe.
A punchy boat engine made from scavenged parts, not good for the environment. More engines means more speed.

The Small Oil Refinery turns [Crude Oil](/items/crude-oil) into low grade fuel, and you'll find static ones already placed at Power Plant, [The Dome](/monument/the-dome), [Water Treatment Plant](/monument/water-treatment-plant), Airfield, Outpost, both Harbors, Launch Site, Train Yard, [Sewer Branch](/monument/sewer-branch) and the Floating Cities. For your own base, buy one at Outpost for 125 scrap or craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 200 wood, 500 frags and 250 low grade fuel. Loot drops are rare, under 2%.

A Smoke Grenade makes a large cloud of opaque greyish white smoke that you can't see through. Cheapest way is the [Outpost](/monument/outpost) vendor at 5 scrap, though that price moves. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 35 [gun powder](/items/gun-powder) and 50 frags, or research it for 40 scrap. In a Green Recycler it gives 17 gun powder and 25 frags, plus a 50% chance of extra gun powder. Crate drops are rare.
Strengthened Glass Window
An internal weapon mod that allows the user to send pings to their team while the weapon is equipped.

The Thompson, or tommy gun, is a medium-damage SMG. The most reliable way to get one is crafting it at a tier 2 workbench for 10 HQM, 100 wood, an [SMG Body](/items/smg-body) and a [Metal Spring](/items/metal-spring), after researching one for 100 scrap or spending 16 blueprint pages on the tech tree. For loot, [Supply Drops](/world/supply-drop) are the best source at 23.44%, with rare Elite Crate drops at 2.8%. The [Travelling Vendor](/world/travelling-vendor) sometimes sells it for 150-200 scrap.
A torpedo for use in a submarine. Fires ahead in a straight line.
A hatch that opens and changes into a ladder.
